ui.hover.purpose: The pointer is on something you can press: the faintest acknowledgement, never tiring even when sweeping across many buttons.
ui.hover.when: Pointer enters a button, a card you can act on, or a choice (rate-limited).

ui.click.purpose: A button was pressed: crisp, short, tactile feedback for any ordinary button.
ui.click.when: Any button press without a more specific sound.

ui.confirm.purpose: A primary action is accepted (OK, Done, Start, Keep, submit): positive, decisive, a step above a click.
ui.confirm.when: The main button of a dialog or prompt is pressed.

ui.cancel.purpose: Backing out (Cancel, Back, Close, Clear, Escape): neutral, lower and softer than confirm, clearly "undo / go back".
ui.cancel.when: A cancel, back, close or clear control, or Escape.

ui.toggleOn.purpose: A switch or checkbox turned on: "engaged", rising.
ui.toggleOn.when: A checkbox or toggle becomes checked.

ui.toggleOff.purpose: A switch or checkbox turned off: "disengaged", falling; the mirror of toggle on.
ui.toggleOff.when: A checkbox or toggle becomes unchecked.

ui.select.purpose: An option is picked (radio, select, a chip, a card in a choice): light, precise, distinct from a click.
ui.select.when: A radio, select, chip or choosable card is chosen.

ui.tick.purpose: A value steps (slider, number +/-, moving an item up or down): a tiny detent, like a digital dial.
ui.tick.when: Each step of a slider or a number control, each reorder.

ui.type.purpose: A key typed in a text field: a faint terminal keystroke, never annoying at typing speed.
ui.type.when: Each character typed into a text field (rate-limited).

ui.navigate.purpose: Moving to another screen: a panel of the grid sliding into place.
ui.navigate.when: The screen changes (top navigation, Back to a previous screen, Home).

ui.open.purpose: A panel, menu or dialog opens: it deploys, rising.
ui.open.when: A dialog, menu, card zone viewer or panel appears.

ui.close.purpose: A panel, menu or dialog closes: it folds away, falling; the mirror of open.
ui.close.when: A dialog, menu or panel is dismissed.

ui.error.purpose: Refused or failed: an unmistakable "denied" that is firm but not harsh or alarming.
ui.error.when: An action is not allowed, or an error message appears.

ui.notify.purpose: A notice appeared: a gentle "incoming message" that draws the eye without urgency.
ui.notify.when: A status message or notice shows up.

ui.success.purpose: Something finished well (saved, imported, uploaded, copied, updated): a satisfying, bright completion.
ui.success.when: A long or important action completes successfully.

ui.delete.purpose: Something is erased for good (a deck, stored images): data wiped, final, a little sobering.

deck.add.purpose: A card goes into the deck: it slots in, rising, satisfying when repeated quickly.
deck.add.when: Add to deck / + on a card in the deckbuilder.

deck.remove.purpose: A card comes out of the deck: it slides out, falling; the mirror of add.
deck.remove.when: Remove / - on a card in the deckbuilder.

deck.legal.purpose: The deck check passed: "verified", a clean approval chime.
deck.legal.when: The deck validation reports the deck legal in its format.

deck.illegal.purpose: The deck check found problems: "needs attention", softer than an error.

game.start.purpose: A game begins: the grid powers up, energy rising into a strong arrival; sets the tone of the whole game.
game.start.when: The game starts (the table appears and the opening hands are dealt).

game.mulligan.purpose: A player mulligans: the hand is recalled and scrambled, a "rewind and retry".

game.keep.purpose: A player keeps their hand: locked in, ready.
game.keep.when: A player keeps their opening hand.

game.shuffle.purpose: A library is shuffled: a rapid digital riffle that settles.
game.shuffle.when: A library is shuffled (game start, mulligan, after a search).

turn.mine.purpose: Your turn begins: the most important recurring cue; warm, bright and instantly recognisable, but welcoming rather than startling (it plays every turn).
turn.mine.when: The "Your turn" banner sweeps across the table.

turn.theirs.purpose: The opponent's turn begins: clearly not yours (darker, lower, calmer), still a clean turn marker.
turn.theirs.when: The opponent's turn banner sweeps across the table.

turn.step.purpose: The game moved to the next step of the turn: a quiet tick of the turn clock.
turn.step.when: A new step or phase begins where a player gets a decision.

priority.mine.purpose: The game is waiting for you: a clear, friendly "your move" prompt, noticeable without startling, fine to hear many times a game.
priority.mine.when: A decision of yours appears in the prompt bar (priority, targets, blockers, ...).

priority.pass.purpose: You passed: a soft "acknowledged, moving on".
priority.pass.when: You pass priority (Pass, OK on an empty stack, Space).

game.handoff.purpose: Hot-seat: hand the device to the other player; the screen locks behind a cover.

game.finalBlow.purpose: A player is defeated: the final, heaviest blow of the game, a system crash of their disc.
game.finalBlow.when: The losing player's disc takes the last hit and the table jolts hard.

game.victory.purpose: You won: triumphant, rewarding, the payoff of the whole game.
game.victory.when: The result screen shows your victory.

game.defeat.purpose: You lost: a dignified power-down, sombre but not punishing.
game.defeat.when: The result screen shows your defeat.

game.drawn.purpose: The game ended with no winner for you (a draw, or a game you watched): neutral, unresolved, final.
game.drawn.when: The result screen shows a draw or a result that is not yours.

game.coin.purpose: A coin is flipped: spinning, then landing on its result.

game.dice.purpose: A die is rolled: tumbling values that settle on a result.

world.day.purpose: It becomes day: light rising over the grid, open and bright.
world.day.when: Night becomes day (or day is first set).

world.night.purpose: It becomes night: light sinking, the grid darkening.

world.crown.purpose: Someone becomes the monarch or takes the initiative: a regal, important designation.
world.crown.when: The monarch or the initiative changes hands.

net.connected.purpose: Online: the link is up (a clean digital handshake).
net.connected.when: The client connects to the online server or the other player.

net.joined.purpose: Online: the opponent joined and the game is on: an arrival, more exciting than connected.
net.joined.when: The online game begins (both players are in).

net.lost.purpose: Online: the connection dropped or the opponent left: signal lost, a worried glitch.
net.lost.when: The link drops, the opponent leaves or the server closes.

net.restored.purpose: Online: the connection is back or the opponent returned: relief, signal restored.
net.restored.when: The link reconnects or the opponent comes back.

net.chat.purpose: Online: a chat message from the opponent: a light "message in".
net.chat.when: A chat message from the opponent arrives.

net.waiting.purpose: Online: still waiting for an opponent: a calm radar ping that can repeat every few seconds.
net.waiting.when: Every few seconds while a hosted game waits for its opponent.

ambient.grid.purpose: The table ambience: a low, slowly breathing grid hum that makes the table a place, never in the way of the effects.
ambient.grid.when: Loops quietly under the game screen.

cast.fire.purpose: A spell is cast and goes on the stack; this one is red spells and fire-named ones (Fireball, Flame Slash). Must read as "a spell is launched" and carry its element's flavour in the grid style.
cast.fire.when: The card lifts out of the hand and flies to the stack (about 0.45 s), with a flare when it arrives.

impact.fire.purpose: A spell's effect strikes its target (red spells and fire-named ones (Fireball, Flame Slash)). Must feel like a hit of that element, rendered digitally; louder for more damage (the game scales its volume).
impact.fire.when: The projectile reaches the card or the player disc: burst of light, the target recoils, the damage number floats up.

cast.lightning.purpose: A spell is cast and goes on the stack; this one is lightning-named spells (Lightning Bolt, Shock) and blue-red ones. Must read as "a spell is launched" and carry its element's flavour in the grid style.
cast.lightning.when: The card lifts out of the hand and flies to the stack (about 0.45 s), with a flare when it arrives.

impact.lightning.purpose: A spell's effect strikes its target (lightning-named spells (Lightning Bolt, Shock) and blue-red ones). Must feel like a hit of that element, rendered digitally; louder for more damage (the game scales its volume).
impact.lightning.when: The projectile reaches the card or the player disc: burst of light, the target recoils, the damage number floats up.

cast.arcane.purpose: A spell is cast and goes on the stack; this one is blue spells: arcane light. Must read as "a spell is launched" and carry its element's flavour in the grid style.
cast.arcane.when: The card lifts out of the hand and flies to the stack (about 0.45 s), with a flare when it arrives.

impact.arcane.purpose: A spell's effect strikes its target (blue spells: arcane light). Must feel like a hit of that element, rendered digitally; louder for more damage (the game scales its volume).
impact.arcane.when: The projectile reaches the card or the player disc: burst of light, the target recoils, the damage number floats up.

cast.shadow.purpose: A spell is cast and goes on the stack; this one is black spells: shadow. Must read as "a spell is launched" and carry its element's flavour in the grid style.
cast.shadow.when: The card lifts out of the hand and flies to the stack (about 0.45 s), with a flare when it arrives.

impact.shadow.purpose: A spell's effect strikes its target (black spells: shadow). Must feel like a hit of that element, rendered digitally; louder for more damage (the game scales its volume).
impact.shadow.when: The projectile reaches the card or the player disc: burst of light, the target recoils, the damage number floats up.

cast.nature.purpose: A spell is cast and goes on the stack; this one is green spells: nature. Must read as "a spell is launched" and carry its element's flavour in the grid style.
cast.nature.when: The card lifts out of the hand and flies to the stack (about 0.45 s), with a flare when it arrives.

impact.nature.purpose: A spell's effect strikes its target (green spells: nature). Must feel like a hit of that element, rendered digitally; louder for more damage (the game scales its volume).
impact.nature.when: The projectile reaches the card or the player disc: burst of light, the target recoils, the damage number floats up.

cast.radiant.purpose: A spell is cast and goes on the stack; this one is white spells: radiance. Must read as "a spell is launched" and carry its element's flavour in the grid style.
cast.radiant.when: The card lifts out of the hand and flies to the stack (about 0.45 s), with a flare when it arrives.

impact.radiant.purpose: A spell's effect strikes its target (white spells: radiance). Must feel like a hit of that element, rendered digitally; louder for more damage (the game scales its volume).
impact.radiant.when: The projectile reaches the card or the player disc: burst of light, the target recoils, the damage number floats up.

cast.force.purpose: A spell is cast and goes on the stack; this one is colourless and artifact spells: raw force. Must read as "a spell is launched" and carry its element's flavour in the grid style.
cast.force.when: The card lifts out of the hand and flies to the stack (about 0.45 s), with a flare when it arrives.

impact.force.purpose: A spell's effect strikes its target (colourless and artifact spells: raw force). Must feel like a hit of that element, rendered digitally; louder for more damage (the game scales its volume).
impact.force.when: The projectile reaches the card or the player disc: burst of light, the target recoils, the damage number floats up.

mana.W.purpose: Mana is made (white): a small, pleasant confirmation that energy was drawn from a land or source, recognisably white next to the other five.
mana.W.when: An orb of mana flies from the tapped source to the spell it pays for (several at once are staggered).

mana.U.purpose: Mana is made (blue): a small, pleasant confirmation that energy was drawn from a land or source, recognisably blue next to the other five.
mana.U.when: An orb of mana flies from the tapped source to the spell it pays for (several at once are staggered).

mana.B.purpose: Mana is made (black): a small, pleasant confirmation that energy was drawn from a land or source, recognisably black next to the other five.
mana.B.when: An orb of mana flies from the tapped source to the spell it pays for (several at once are staggered).

mana.R.purpose: Mana is made (red): a small, pleasant confirmation that energy was drawn from a land or source, recognisably red next to the other five.
mana.R.when: An orb of mana flies from the tapped source to the spell it pays for (several at once are staggered).

mana.G.purpose: Mana is made (green): a small, pleasant confirmation that energy was drawn from a land or source, recognisably green next to the other five.
mana.G.when: An orb of mana flies from the tapped source to the spell it pays for (several at once are staggered).

mana.C.purpose: Mana is made (colourless): a small, pleasant confirmation that energy was drawn from a land or source, recognisably colourless next to the other five.
mana.C.when: An orb of mana flies from the tapped source to the spell it pays for (several at once are staggered).

spell.resolve.purpose: A spell or ability starts to resolve: "executing", it flares and releases its effect.
spell.resolve.when: The spell rises off the stack, grows and glows before its effect leaves it.

spell.bolt.purpose: A spell's effect is in flight toward its target: a fast travelling whoosh that leads into the impact.
spell.bolt.when: The projectile leaves the spell (it lands about 0.35 s later).

spell.touch.purpose: A spell reaches what it targets without damage (pump, tap, destroy target, ...): the effect is applied, "data written".
spell.touch.when: The effect lands on its target: light behind the card and a glow pulse.

spell.countered.purpose: A spell or ability is countered: negated, it breaks apart on the stack. A decisive "denied".
spell.countered.when: The countered spell jolts on the stack and shatters.

spell.copied.purpose: A spell is copied: duplicated, an echo of the original.
spell.copied.when: A copy of a spell appears on the stack.

ability.activated.purpose: An activated ability is used: a permanent powers a function, a quick charge.
ability.activated.when: Its source flares and pulses blue.

ability.triggered.purpose: A triggered ability fires on its own: an alert "something happened because of this card", golden.
ability.triggered.when: Its source flares and pulses gold.

combat.attack.purpose: Attackers are declared: aggressive, charging forward; light cycles revving into the attack.
combat.attack.when: The attackers move forward and pulse red-orange.

combat.block.purpose: Blockers are declared: defensive, a digital barrier slamming into place.
combat.block.when: The blockers step in front of the attackers and pulse blue.

combat.arm.purpose: You chose a creature to attack with (or took it back): weapon armed, a quick aggressive select.
combat.arm.when: Clicking a creature while declaring attackers.

combat.assign.purpose: You chose a blocker or the attacker it blocks: a defensive assignment click, distinct from arm.
combat.assign.when: Clicking a blocker or an attacker while declaring blockers.

combat.swing.purpose: A creature rises and lunges at its target: the wind-up whoosh before the hit.
combat.swing.when: The creature lifts off the table and swings (contact comes about 0.28 s in).

hit.light.purpose: A blow lands for 1-2 damage: a crisp, light digital hit.
hit.light.when: Contact of a creature (or a damage source) with its target.

hit.medium.purpose: A blow lands for 3-5 damage: a solid, punchy hit.
hit.medium.when: Contact, with a small screen shake.

hit.heavy.purpose: A blow lands for 6+ damage: a massive, crunching impact.
hit.heavy.when: Contact, with a strong screen shake and a flash.

hit.player.purpose: Damage hits a player: the player's own system takes the blow, heavier and more alarming than a hit on a card.
hit.player.when: The blow lands on the player's disc and the life total drops.

life.gain.purpose: A player gains life: restorative, rising, a healing shimmer.
life.gain.when: Healing light on the player disc, a green +N floats up.

life.loss.purpose: A player loses life without damage (paying life, drain): energy drained away, falling.
life.loss.when: A dark burst on the player disc, a red -N floats up.

counter.up.purpose: Helpful counters are added (+1/+1, loyalty, charge): an upgrade, a level up.
counter.up.when: Green motes rise around the card and "+1 +1/+1" floats up.

counter.down.purpose: Harmful counters are added or counters removed: a downgrade.
counter.down.when: Red motes around the card, "-1" floats up.

stat.up.purpose: A creature gets bigger (pump, anthem): powered up, a quick boost.
stat.up.when: The card pulses green and "+2/+2" floats up.

stat.down.purpose: A creature gets smaller: weakened, a power sag.
stat.down.when: The card pulses red and "-2/-2" floats up.

damage.prevented.purpose: Damage is prevented: a shield deflects the blow, a bright ricochet.

card.draw.purpose: A card is drawn: a quick data pull from the library into the hand; several in a row read as a quick cascade.
card.draw.when: The card flies from the library into the hand (several are 90 ms apart).

card.land.purpose: A land is played: solid, grounded, it locks into the grid and powers up.
card.land.when: The land lands on the table.

card.enter.purpose: A permanent spell resolves and lands on the battlefield: materialized, arrived, with weight.
card.enter.when: The card flies from the stack and lands on the table with dust.

card.enterHeavy.purpose: A big creature (power 4 or more) lands: a heavy, ground-shaking arrival.
card.enterHeavy.when: The card lands and the table shakes.

card.token.purpose: A token is created: it materializes from nothing, a program compiling into the grid; lighter than a card entering.
card.token.when: The token scales up out of a burst of light.

card.destroy.purpose: A permanent is destroyed or dies: it shatters and derezzes into voxels. Dramatic, final, the Tron signature.
card.destroy.when: The card is struck, cracks and bursts into flying shards.

card.sacrifice.purpose: A permanent is sacrificed: given up, it sinks and is consumed in a dark swirl (not broken like destroy).
card.sacrifice.when: The card sinks into the table in purple smoke.

card.exile.purpose: A card is exiled: banished, drawn into a single point of light and gone.
card.exile.when: The card flares white and shrinks into a point.

card.bounce.purpose: A permanent returns to its owner's hand: recalled, a reverse whoosh back.
card.bounce.when: The card flies back to the hand.

card.toGraveyard.purpose: A card goes to a graveyard (a finished spell, a discard, a mill): filed away, a soft downward swish.
card.toGraveyard.when: The card flies into the graveyard pile.

card.toLibrary.purpose: A card goes into a library: tucked away into the deck.
card.toLibrary.when: The card flies into the library pile.

card.tap.purpose: A permanent is tapped: a small, crisp mechanical-digital "clack" as it turns sideways.

card.untap.purpose: Your permanents untap: a quick reset sweep, everything ready again (once for the whole board).
card.untap.when: The untap step: the tapped cards turn upright.

card.flip.purpose: A card transforms, flips or turns face up or down: a phase shift into another form.
card.flip.when: A flash of light and a pop as the new face shows.

card.attach.purpose: An Aura or Equipment is attached: docked and locked on, magnetic.
card.attach.when: The attachment moves under the permanent it now enchants or equips.

card.control.purpose: A permanent changes control: hacked and reassigned to the other side.
card.control.when: The card moves to the other player's side.

card.phase.purpose: A permanent phases out: it flickers out of existence for a while.
card.phase.when: The permanent fades out of play.

card.reveal.purpose: Cards are revealed or looked at (scry, surveil, reveal): a scan exposing data.
card.reveal.when: A reveal notice shows the cards.

card.search.purpose: A library is searched: scanning through data for a match.

card.zoom.purpose: A card is enlarged for a closer look: a soft optical zoom-in, unobtrusive.
card.zoom.when: The card zoom opens (hover or press on a card).

card.pickup.purpose: You pick up a card from your hand: lifted, ready to be played.
card.pickup.when: A drag of a hand card starts.

card.drop.purpose: You let go of a card over the table to play it: released, committed.
card.drop.when: A dragged card is dropped past the play line.

card.target.purpose: You chose a target: target locked, precise and confident.
card.target.when: A card or player is chosen as a target.

card.targeted.purpose: The opponent targets something of yours: a warning lock-on alert, attention without panic.
card.targeted.when: The opponent's spell or ability targets your card or you (a targeting arrow appears).
